summary_en: This study is testing hypofractionated whole pelvis proton therapy with a brachytherapy boost in men with prostate cancer that is high risk or unfavorable intermediate risk, with an elevated risk of lymph node involvement. The brachytherapy boost is given first, followed by whole pelvis proton radiation therapy in 5 fractions, while the standard treatment uses 25 fractions. The study measures safety, as stated in the official title; the specific safety outcome measures are not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la radioterapia de pelvis completa con protones en hipofraccionamiento, con un refuerzo de braquiterapia, en hombres con cáncer de próstata de riesgo alto o intermedio desfavorable, con mayor riesgo de afectación de ganglios linfáticos. Primero se administra el refuerzo de braquiterapia, seguido de radioterapia de pelvis completa con protones en 5 fracciones, mientras que el tratamiento estándar usa 25 fracciones. El estudio mide la seguridad, según se indica en el título oficial; las medidas específicas de seguridad no se indican.
who_for: High risk or unfavorable intermediate risk prostate cancer
Appropriate for whole pelvis radiation per the treating oncologist or lymph node nomogram
Candidate for definitive external beam radiation with no prior radiation to the study region
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0-2
not_for: History of inflammatory bowel disease or active connective tissue disorders
Second invasive cancer within five years, other than non-melanoma skin cancer
Known severe, active comorbidity that the investigators judge would interfere with study treatment
